node.statement: Unpacking O(e) in the amplified C*-norm upper estimate yields universal finite kappa >= 0 and e_sq > 0, independent of the datum and n, such that ||Z^dagger dot Z|| <= (1+kappa*e)||Z||^2 whenever e <= e_sq. Together with the zero-space case this proves node 1.1.
